profile.name: Flask网络服务
profile.description: 用于管理基于 Flask 的 HTTP 网络服务的软件组件，可注册 API 路由并启动或停止服务器，常用于实验系统的远程控制与接口集成。它不是物理实验仪器。
profile.description_en: A software component that manages a Flask-based HTTP web service. It can register API routes and start or stop the server, and is commonly used for remote control and interface integration in lab systems. It is not a physical laboratory instrument.
